Record notes

Investigate questions with traceable evidence; plan studies, analyze supplied qualitative data, revise academic writing and hand off findings.

Version 1.1.1+ecosystem.20261010 includes 8 complete skill procedures. Eight complete maintained methods and licensed support resources; optional publisher-installed extensions and recipient-bound Research Compass backend.

Requirements: Your research question and authorized source material; Optional Python 3 for bundled compiler and Research Compass launcher; Optional Research Compass backend with recipient-owned private binding; Optional publisher-installed AIHumanizer, Research Writing Guardrails and UI UX Designer skills for named provider procedures; Reasoning Toolkit for Critical Compass audits.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add research-methodology-local@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 30a3a2c3ae84dd1b1dad874c5aca91014b4e238a. SHA-256: c96528e6411ebd0afbef1540376177ed68828691078208f636517d1f08041321.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
